spans.s:
f. (-री)
A cricket.
E.
झि imitative of the cricket's chirp, रा to make, affixes ड and ङीष्; also झिल्ली; also झिरिका, कन् being added; also इ pen. being made long झिरीका, or changed to उ, झिरुका; the first vowel also being lengthened झीरिका, and झीरुका, &c.

f. (-का)
A cricket: see the last.
